answer: Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nadir re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
